name: shiny-button

frames.best_why: The light band is clearly caught mid-sweep across the Request access label.

tagline: Dark pill buttons with a light sweep running across label and border.
summary: Two dark outline buttons in a card whose labels and edges catch a soft light band that keeps travelling across them, giving a quiet metallic shimmer.
appearance: A rounded dark card holds a white heading, a short grey line of text, and two side-by-side pill buttons with thin light borders. Each button carries a small, widely spaced uppercase label in a muted tone.
behaviour: A narrow light band slides across each label and around the border, pauses, then sweeps again in a loop. A button also casts a faint glow on hover and dips in size when pressed.
demo_content: A waitlist card headed Join the waitlist with Request access and Learn more buttons.
search_phrases: subtle light effect on a button
use_when: A primary call to action should shimmer subtly instead of shouting with colour.
avoid_when: Pages with many buttons; the looping shine becomes noisy when repeated.
customise: Pass the label as children and add classes; the sweep timing, spring and border mask are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A small mask sweep loops over a couple of buttons; nothing heavy runs.

a11y.note: It is a real button with a text label, but the looping shine ignores reduced-motion and there is no custom focus style.

issues: The shine repeats every second across both buttons, which is distracting in a pair.
polish_why: Restrained metallic sweep on a tidy card; the cycle is frequent enough to distract.
